title: Halo Use Case
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.production_build: passed: TypeScript and Vite; dist/index.html exists
checks.desktop: passed: Chromium 1440x1000, two columns, 720px card, no horizontal overflow
checks.mobile: passed: Chromium 390x844, stacked layout, 720px card, no horizontal overflow
checks.button: passed: hover color transition, click, keyboard focus and Enter activation
checks.font: TT Norms Pro Regular loaded in both viewports
checks.video: loaded and autoplaying muted in both viewports; playback advances, loop and playsInline enabled

asset_issues.observation: Chromium recorded net::ERR_ABORTED requests during media handling/seeking. Video loaded with readyState 4, no media error, and successful advancing playback in both viewports. Raw requests retained in browser report.

notes: Implemented only the supplied Halo Use Case design with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and lucide-react.
Uses the exact external font stylesheet and MP4 URL supplied in PROMPT.md.
Know more has no destination or additional action specified in the prompt; it retains the reference button behavior.
Full-page screenshots use a consistent video frame at two seconds. Production video plays normally.
External font and video require network availability.
Ready means ready for review; no deployment or push performed.
